tagline: An EDA environment for schematics, PCB layout, verification and simulation. Written so far: model, project file, board, schematic and EAGLE files.
description: EH3D-PHOENIX-PCB is planned as an EDA environment with schematic capture, PCB layout, verification tools, circuit simulation and specialized modules for switch-mode power supplies and RF. Today it holds a workspace with a redacted inventory of a private corpus of design files, the foundations of the design model (checked integer units, object ids, canonical JSON), the project file on the shared container of EH3D-COMMON, the board model with silkscreen and reversible operations, rule checks, the connectivity and rule engine, the schematic with a drawing, a reader of EAGLE XML files, a writer and reader of boards as EAGLE XML, the contract for pairs of EAGLE binary files, the manufacturing export (Gerber X2, Excellon, placement, bill of materials and a manifest of checksums), a calculator of board stack-ups and transmission lines (microstrip, stripline, coplanar waveguide, coupled pairs), RF tools (Touchstone files, two-port parameters, matching and ideal ladder filters) and a command line; all of it has only been tried on generated or hand-made data, and the editors, the readers of foreign designs and the reader of the EAGLE binary files are not written.
